# Part 05 · Sampling & Temperature

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcUOXUfRbHx/) · Published 21 Aug 2026

> How does a model pick its next word, and what does temperature change?

Send the same prompt twice and you get two different answers. The model scores every word in its vocabulary, then samples one.

## The idea

- Softmax turns the raw scores (logits) into probabilities that add up to 1.
- Temperature divides the logits first: low sharpens the top choice, high flattens the curve.
- Top-p keeps only the smallest set of words covering p of the probability, so a high temperature doesn't pick nonsense.

## The formula

$$
P(w_i) = \frac{\exp(z_i / T)}{\sum_j \exp(z_j / T)}
$$
